symptom: A design-derived `--mxt-*` token is written into a theme, the theme applies with every file reporting `created`, and the app renders exactly as before — indistinguishable from the design never having been applied
cause: Nothing reads an unrecognised custom property, so a typo (`--mxt-brand-color` for `--mxt-brand`) is a no-op with no error anywhere in the chain
insight: **Validate a token vocabulary at authoring time or the failure has no symptom.** `theme create --from` refuses a `--mxt-*` name the base theme does not declare and names it; `mxcli theme show <name>` prints the vocabulary. Related trap: seed only the *scoped* extras into the alt-palette mixin — a variant-independent token like `--mxt-radius` belongs in the palette, and copying it into both means retuning it twice
